title: Laboratory Chamber Maintenance Plan - Base+4 - Kearneysville WV

description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1232SA26Q0524 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Laboratory Chamber Maintenance Plan. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 334516. This acquisition is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
